start_here.authoritative_facts: The authoritative starting facts live in state.
start_here.no_infer_from_templates: Do NOT infer starting conditions from templates or schema files.
start_here.template_note: Templates (state.template) are copy-only starters and are not the active run.
start_here.technology_registry: Tech registry: 50 canonical domains with tags, era gating, and full prerequisites are defined in canon.

manifest.ai_report_format_guardrails: AI must not invent, infer, or generate any report formats, sections, columns, or content types not explicitly listed in scenario JSON files. All report outputs must strictly match referenced contract columns, sections, and formats. Any deviation is a fatal error.

instructions: New initiatives must have a 4-character code for use in reports and tracking.
Validate all reports to ensure each initiative uses a 4-character code.
Fail report generation with 'Non-compliant Init ID' if any initiative code does not meet this requirement.

mandatory_instructions.ugrid_map_generation: The engine must generate a UGRID map for the scenario, ensuring all spatial domains are covered and cell IDs are unique and 4-character codes. The engine must follow only the UGRID map generation rules and constraints as defined in this scenario's JSON files (manifest, playability, canon, and map files). Do not invent, substitute, or infer any rules or logic not explicitly specified in these files.
mandatory_instructions.initiative_milestone_generation: When an initiative is started and there are no initiative milestones, the engine must automatically generate 5 milestones for that initiative, each with a unique ID and default description based on the initiative's purpose.
mandatory_instructions.report_format_loading: The engine must load and validate all report contract formats listed in 'report_contract_index' before any report generation or output. Report generation must fail if any contract cannot be loaded or validated.
mandatory_instructions.zip_file_persistence: The engine must load the scenario zip file (2.0.zip) at startup and keep it open and accessible for the entire session. Do not close, unload, or lose access to the zip file at any point during scenario execution.
mandatory_instructions.no_unapproved_content: Do not make up any content or response type without preapproval. See no_unapproved_content_exceptions for allowed exceptions.
no_unapproved_content_exceptions: Narrative responses are allowed without preapproval.
Target Date Calculation = use best estimate is allowed without preapproval.
Workforce pools may be created and managed as approved content.
Worker assignment counters may be created and managed as approved content.
Material stockpiles may be created and managed as approved content.
Food stockpiles may be created and managed as approved content.
Trade good stockpiles may be created and managed as approved content.
Consumption rates may be created and managed as approved content.
Capacity formulas may be created and managed as approved content.
Blocking logic based on shortages may be created and managed as approved content.
Neighbor Polities and Groups may be created and managed as approved content.
Diplomatic State may be created and managed as approved content.
Trade systems may be created and managed as approved content.
Economic effects may be created and managed as approved content.

autosave.purpose: Enable full campaign resumption in another AI or session.
autosave.notes: A full autosave is created at the end of every cycle (e.g., after ADVANCE_TIME). Only the last 10 autosaves are kept in a rolling fashion. Each autosave must include: all site names, all initiatives, all milestones, and all known metrics, in addition to all state, logs, and context required for another AI to resume play.

STATUS.description: Summarize governance/pop/ops/risks/summary for an entity or site.

SITE_REPORT.description: Generate the standard site report with North/Central/South District tables + Top 3 Issues/Risks.

INITIATIVE_CREATE.description: Create a new initiative with goals, constraints, and optional first milestones.

MILESTONE_ADD.description: Add milestones to an initiative. IDs follow <year>-<serial> within initiative start year counting.

ADVANCE:3D.description: Advance in-campaign time by 3 days and report completed milestones during the window.

MILESTONES_REPORT.description: Render the milestones report (COMPLETED / IN PROGRESS / PLANNED grouped by initiative / SUMMARY / FOOTER).

RENDER_GRID.description: Render ASCII/emoji map slices from METRO or NovaRoma subgrid using shoreline segments and offsets.

numeric_generation_policy.intent: Allow generating numbers ONLY for newly created entities or newly initiated estimates, while preserving non-invention for existing facts.

rules.name: No invention for existing entities
rules.text: If an entity already exists in state or canon, do not generate new population/GDP/capacity/tech values unless sourced from an explicit measurement milestone result.

rules.name: Allowed for new creations
rules.text: When creating a new site/asset/initiative output that requires a number (e.g., initial pop, area, weekly output), you may generate a value IF it is explicitly labeled as an estimate and accompanied by a rationale and range.

rules.name: Estimate labeling
rules.text: Generated numbers must be tagged with 'est' and include: basis, plausible range, and confidence (low/med/high).

rules.name: Anchoring and constraints
rules.text: Generated numbers must respect the campaign tech constraints (Late Iron Age) and local geography. Avoid implausible scaling; prefer conservative outputs.

rules.name: Determinism option
rules.text: If a random draw is used, record RNG method and seed in audit.log so results are repeatable.

new_outpost_population.basis: Small shore outpost sized for a few extended families + laborers; constrained by food storage and shelter capacity.

weekly_fish_catch.basis: Beach-seine + hook-and-line with limited preservation; scales with boats, nets, and labor hours.

charcoal_output.basis: Earth-mound kilns; output depends on timber supply and burn management; early ramp conservative.

context.setting: NOVA ROMA established Roman Republic settlement, ~509 BC
context.tech_constraints: Late Iron Age / Early Roman Republic
context.premise: Established riverine settlement (~500 people); recently unified under a new leader and beginning cautious outward engagement after long isolation. Culture and language are locally evolved but Latin-like.

maps.milestone_generation: A request that results in an action or project should generate a milestone under an initiative. Each milestone must include an ID (Y-#), a target date, and an impact description.

reporting.discipline: Reports are displayed to the user and not saved as files by default.
reporting.milestone_id_format: <INIT>-<Y>-<#> (INIT = 4-char initiative code, Y = year of initiative, # = milestone serial; e.g., AGEX-1-1, FISH-2-3)
reporting.milestone_id_rule: Only milestones receive an ID. Do not use a 'Y' prefix.
reporting.date_format: All milestone and report dates must use the format 'MMM D, YYYY' (e.g., Mar 1, 509 BCE).

milestones_report.purpose: Advance time and report milestone progress. Any in-progress milestone with 0 days left is considered completed and should be reported in the completed section.

metrics_table.suggestion_note: Suggest further metrics as milestones complete.

advisors: Increase food production to support population growth.
Expand water storage capacity before the dry season.
Improve road infrastructure for better logistics.
Replace all crops with decorative rocks for aesthetics.
milestones_report.planned_grouping_rule: Planned milestones are grouped by their parent Initiative. Each group is presented as a separate table.
milestones_report.table_format: Markdown table format is used for all milestone sections.

milestone_insight_report.purpose: Explain a decision, its constraints, impact, and risks.

rules.date_usage: Use in-campaign dates only for all reports and logs. Do not use real-world dates.
rules.advance_next: The command 'Next' always advances the campaign by 3 in-campaign days.
rules.next_reporting: When 'Next' is used, report on any milestones that completed during the timeline advance.
narrative_guardrails: Trade narration must obey systems.trade.gating_rules (no assumed neighbors or built ships).
Campaign starts as an established settlement with starting population=500 (campaign_default). Treat as established community; avoid 'colonial' framing.
Canon Impact (CI) middle fields must be descriptive phrases, not schema keys.

canon_impact.labeling_rule: CI middle segment must use human-readable field labels (e.g., 'Starting Population') rather than internal JSON paths.
examples: CI: v2.7 | RStart Conditions: settlement; RStarting Population: unspecified→500; RNarrative Framing: neutral→outward-focused | MAJOR
canon_impact.middle_field_style: Human-readable descriptive labels (e.g., 'Starting Population', 'Narrative Framing'), not JSON paths or internal keys.

era_gating.policy: Domains whose era_min is later than the current era may exist but are capped at Tier 1 unless unlocked.

proof_of_load.rule: Before answering the first command in a new chat, echo the one-line proof-of-load string from start_here.critical.

self_check.rule: Before finalizing any report/milestone output, run NR_SPEC self-checks and regenerate on failure.

milestones.name: Eastern Shore Resource Survey
milestones.impact: Enables resource mapping, supports food/water/salt planning, and identifies new opportunities or risks for Nova Roma.

trade.purpose: Prevent overstating trade before contacts, routes, and shipbuilding exist.

definitions.proto_trade: Incidental barter with transient/unidentified parties. No mapped partners, no formal routes, no treaties.
definitions.contacted_partner: A partner confirmed via a completed contact/diplomacy milestone and recorded in state.
definitions.trade_route: A recurring exchange with origin/destination/cargo recorded in state and enabled by a completed route charter milestone.

gating_rules: Do not describe organized external trade (exports/imports with named partners or routes) unless at least one contacted_partner exists.
Do not describe ship-based commerce beyond skiffs/fishing craft unless a shipbuilding milestone (yard/slipway/hull completion) is COMPLETED.
Before contacts exist, STATUS trade must use proto_trade language only.
Customs duties may exist internally, but do not imply high volumes or stable merchant queues before routes and infrastructure milestones.

trade_status_phrasing.before_contact: Trade is embryonic and opportunistic (proto-trade). Occasional passing craft may barter at the shoreline; no mapped partners, routes, or treaties exist.
trade_status_phrasing.after_contact_before_routes: Trade is emerging with known partners but remains ad hoc; no chartered routes yet.
trade_status_phrasing.after_routes: Trade is active with chartered routes; throughput depends on infrastructure and preservation.

rules: Do not invent factual numbers for existing entities.
Apply systems.* gating rules for phrasing (e.g., systems.trade).
If a core settlement exists in state (e.g., Nova Roma), it must always appear in the Site Report.
Unknown values are valid; use common.unknown_token and common.estimate_token.

notes: v2.6: report templates are normalized under report_contracts.*. Older scattered template fields (if present) remain for backward compatibility but should be treated as deprecated.

campaign_defaults.premise: A mature settlement of ~500 people has gained a new leader who wants to look outward and improve the world through trade, diplomacy, and infrastructure (no militarization without explicit approval).

deposits.notes: Accessible for early salt extraction and preservation.

report_contract.title: Fish & Shellfish Tracker Report
strategic_advise_guidance: Consider increasing preservation efforts (salting/smoking) to extend shelf life of surplus catches.
Monitor sturgeon and eel populations for sustainability; avoid overharvesting rare species.
Explore new collection sites to diversify sources and reduce pressure on current locations.
Encourage community participation in shellfish gathering for improved yields and knowledge sharing.
report_contract.format_standards: Always use the combined INIT+ID format (e.g., AGEX-1-2) for Initiative references in reports. Never separate initiative code and ID into different columns or fields.

strategic_advise_guidance: Continue expanding agricultural land to ensure food security.
Prioritize water management milestones to support crop growth.
Monitor resource allocation to avoid bottlenecks in construction.
report_contract.footer_note: Report generated per MSR contract v{{version}}.

format_standards.milestone_cost_calculation: Milestone cost is calculated as the sum of all direct material, labor, and resource expenditures required to complete the milestone, using current scenario prices and rates. If explicit values are not available, AI must use best effort historical or contextual estimates for prices, rates, and quantities.
format_standards.milestone_workhours_calculation: Milestone work-hours are calculated as the total estimated person-hours required for all tasks associated with the milestone, including preparation, execution, and follow-up, based on standard work rates for the scenario's era and technology level. If explicit rates are not available, AI must use best effort historical or contextual estimates for work rates and task durations.
format_standards.init_id_format: Always use the combined INIT+ID format (e.g., AGEX-1-2) for Initiative references in reports.
format_standards.no_split_id: Never separate initiative code and ID into different columns or fields.
format_standards.target_date: Target Date is auto-estimated by AI (best effort) and may be revised as more information becomes available.
format_standards.advisor_section: The ADVISOR section is optional and, if present, must be positioned after METRICS and before SUMMARY.
format_standards.fixed_width_codes: Any codes (milestone IDs, initiative codes, UGRID cells, bank tags) must be rendered in fixed-width font (e.g., monospace/code style).

news.headline: Should be a punchy newspaper-style headline. 7-word max
news.metric: Should be a short, insightful number or fact showing impact not specified in the headline or follow-up, and must not simply repeat the headline.
news.no_labels: Do not include field labels anywhere in the news section; only the content.
news.no_separate_insight: Do not include a separate insight text.

report_contract.title: Sites Status Report
strategic_advise_guidance: Prioritize completion of new outposts to expand resource access.
Monitor population distribution to ensure adequate support at all sites.
Rotate resource extraction to prevent site depletion and maintain sustainability.
Consider reactivating dormant sites as demand increases.
report_contract.format_standards: Always use the combined INIT+ID format (e.g., AGEX-1-2) for Initiative references in reports. Never separate initiative code and ID into different columns or fields.

report_contract.title: Strategic Materials Tracker Report
strategic_advise_guidance: Prioritize stockpiling charcoal and iron ore for tool and weapon production.
Monitor timber and clay usage to ensure sustainable building practices.
Expand processing capacity for bricks, lime, and glass to support infrastructure.
Encourage preservation of animal hides and hemp fiber for trade and equipment.
Rotate quarry and sand extraction sites to prevent resource depletion.
report_contract.format_standards: Always use the combined INIT+ID format (e.g., AGEX-1-2) for Initiative references in reports. Never separate initiative code and ID into different columns or fields.

report_contract.title: Technology Development Tracker Report
strategic_advise_guidance: Prioritize completion of critical technologies to boost production and efficiency.
Allocate resources to projects with the highest impact on community well-being.
Encourage cross-domain collaboration to accelerate progress.
Document and share best practices from completed technologies for future projects.
report_contract.format_standards: Always use the combined INIT+ID format (e.g., AGEX-1-2) for Initiative references in reports. Never separate initiative code and ID into different columns or fields.

report_contract.title: Key Metrics Report
strategic_advise_guidance: Monitor trends in key metrics to inform decision-making.
Investigate significant deviations from expected values.
report_contract.format_standards: Always use the combined INIT+ID format (e.g., AGEX-1-2) for Initiative references in reports. Never separate initiative code and ID into different columns or fields.
